one_liner: Customizable work-management and collaboration platform (owned by Citrix/Cloud Software Group) with an app-building API.

auth.evidence_quote: The Podio API uses the [OAuth2 protocol](http://oauth.net/2/) for authentication.
auth.notes: Docs describe server-side, client-side, and app-authentication (client-credential-style, for automated scripts against a single Podio 'app') OAuth2 flows; all require a registered Client ID/Secret.

access.notes: Registering a Podio API client (Client ID/Secret) appears self-serve per docs structure, but a free Podio account's API rate limits/eligibility were not independently confirmed within the call budget.

api.notes: Did not check for an MCP server within the 4-call budget; endpoint count not tallied.

verdict.rationale: Self-serve OAuth2 client registration against a documented REST API, no explicit approval gate found in docs.
